summary.intent: Fix two Claude Code config issues (blank statusline, Stop-hook error on every turn), update GSD to 1.6.0, clean up stale worktrees, then run the full GSD planning pipeline for Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) so the user could go AFK while execution proceeded autonomously.
summary.outcome: Both hook issues fixed (statusline.cjs rename + GSD 1.6.0 clean install restoring gsd-context-monitor.js); 3 stale worktrees removed; Phase 61 fully planned with 5 plans across 4 waves, adversarially verified (2-round convergence, zero remaining blockers), hardened against vacuous-pass KAT holes, and all artifacts committed — execution (execute-phase 61 → ship-phase) was queued for autonomous AFK run but had not started at transcript end.

repo: package.json has `"type": "module"` — every .js file in the project is treated as ESM by Node. Claude Code hooks written in CommonJS must use the .cjs extension or they silently blank/crash on require() calls.

GSD hooks are gitignored via .gitignore:55 (`.claude/hooks/gsd-*`) — they are installed by npx and regenerated per-clone, never tracked. A partial or stale install leaves settings.local.json wiring hooks that don't exist on disk.
vitest is configured with `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` — test files placed outside `packages/crypto/src/` (e.g. `packages/crypto/__tests__/`) are silently ignored and never run.

`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array. Adding a new KAT vector file (e.g. `tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json`) requires explicitly registering it in that array or the CI parity-check step fails even when both Rust and TS tests pass.

`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV and cannot produce a fixed output — fixed-IV KAT vectors must target the lower-level `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` functions, matching the pattern used by existing `aes-gcm.json` vectors.
`uuid` crate (v1.23.4) is not yet in the workspace `Cargo.toml` or `crates/crypto/Cargo.toml` — Phase 61 adds it as the only new dependency.

GSD is installed as `@opengsd/gsd-core` via npx (gitignored). The .gitignore comment pinned 1.6.0 but the main-tree install was a broken fragment missing `gsd-tools.cjs`, the file manifest, most workflows, and several hooks. Complete installs only existed in now-removed worktrees.
TypeORM migrations live in `apps/api`, not `packages/crypto` or `crates/crypto` — schema-push gate correctly self-skips for changes confined to the crypto packages.

Commit signing uses 1Password SSH, requiring biometric approval per commit — autonomous AFK sessions must disable commit signing locally (`git config commit.gpgsign false`) or every subagent commit hangs indefinitely.

The GSD gsd-tools STATE update helper returns `updated: []` (empty) when STATE.md is already partially in the expected state — manual hand-edits to STATE.md are sometimes needed after planning completes.

code.finding: Project-level statusLine overrides the global one and previously pointed at `statusline.js` — now correctly points at `statusline.cjs` after the ESM/CJS fix.

Wires gsd-context-monitor.js into 4 hook events (including Stop). This file is gitignored and must be installed by GSD — a partial install leaves it wired but missing, causing MODULE_NOT_FOUND on every turn.
`.claude/hooks/gsd-*` is gitignored — all GSD-managed hooks are local-only and regenerated by the installer. Never assume they're present after a fresh clone.

Contains a wrong test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts`). Correct path is `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts` per vitest include config. The ROADMAP.md SC#3 also has the stale path — documented in VALIDATION.md line 68 but not corrected in ROADMAP.
Contains a hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array. New KAT vector files must be explicitly added here; there is no auto-discovery.

workflow: GSD reinstall (`npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<ver> -- gsd-core --claude --local`) is the correct fix for a broken/partial GSD fragment — hand-copying from worktrees is wrong because worktree copies can be divergent from the manifest hash.

The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative pattern: it reports failure but the commit actually lands. Always verify with `git log` immediately after a helper-mediated commit rather than retrying.
`git worktree remove` removes the working directory without deleting the branch — always verify branch disposition separately after worktree cleanup.

Adversarial multi-lens plan verification (parity-rigor, threat-model, implementation-feasibility lenses run in parallel) caught a vacuous-pass KAT hole that the canonical plan-checker missed — iterating `for...of` over an array without asserting its length passes when the array is empty.

For crypto phases, the plan-checker + multi-lens adversarial review in ultracode mode produces a 2-round convergence workflow: round 1 surfaces BLOCKERs, auto-revision loop, round 2 confirms zero blockers. This catches issues at plan time where fixes are cheap vs. post-execution.
Pattern-mapper independently re-confirmed all four research findings — running it as a separate pre-planner step provides a useful redundant check on research accuracy.

Auto-advance (`--auto` flag + `auto_advance: true` in config) chains planning directly into execution — for security-critical crypto phases, explicitly note the intent to pause before execution rather than relying on the flag being overridden.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negatives: appeared to fail on multiple commits but they actually landed — required `git log` verification after every helper-mediated commit to avoid duplicate commits.

GSD main-tree install was silently broken (fragment with no manifest, missing hooks, missing gsd-tools.cjs) — the fragment produced no error on startup, so the breakage only surfaced via the Stop-hook error and the inability to run the update workflow.
The worktree copy of `gsd-context-monitor.js` had a divergent hash from the manifest, making it unusable as a restore source — forced a full reinstall rather than a targeted file copy.
STATE.md gsd-tools helper returned `updated: []` after planning completed — the helper silently did nothing, requiring a manual read + hand-edit to record planning status.
CONTEXT.md contained a wrong test path that would have caused the Phase 61 TS KAT to be silently ignored by vitest — caught by the researcher subagent, not by any automated gate.

1Password SSH commit signing is incompatible with AFK autonomous sessions — every commit in an unattended subagent run would hang on biometric approval, requiring a session-scoped signing override before going AFK.
open_items: Phase 61 execution not yet started — `gsd-execute-phase 61` (5-plan, 4-wave implementation: TS + Rust AAD primitives, KAT vectors, transplant suite, ADR + docs) was queued for AFK run but the transcript ends before it begins.

Commit signing disabled locally for AFK session — re-enable with `git config --unset commit.gpgsign` and rebase/re-sign commits before the PR is reviewed; the ship-phase PR will show a red signature check.
Branches `fix/phase60-safety-tail` and `fix/fuse-delete-share-revocation` still exist after worktree removal — decide whether to delete, merge, or keep them.
GSD worktrees were on 1.4.3 while main tree is now on 1.6.0 — worktrees are gone so this is resolved, but any new worktrees created via GSD will inherit the 1.6.0 main-tree install.
ROADMAP.md SC#3 still references the stale test path `packages/crypto/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts` — documented in VALIDATION.md but the ROADMAP itself was not corrected.

Phase 61 plans 61-01 and 61-03 were hardened with vector-count assertions (TS side) during this session — the same vacuous-pass pattern should be audited in existing KAT tests for phases 62+ before their planning runs.

Phase 61 open questions deferred: `node-aad.json` single-file vs two-file layout; hand-freeze vectors vs extending `generate-test-vectors.ts`; `CryptoError` variant name `InvalidAadInput` — the planner adopted the researcher's recommendations but these were not formally resolved in CONTEXT.md.
